title: HSK1 Gate 9 · Western Jin
explanationEn: Gate 9: Western Jin. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第9关：西晋。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一千六百多年以前，晋朝有一个人，叫王羲之。他很小的时候就开始学写字。他每天都练习，一天也没有停过。写完字，他就去河边洗笔。
passageEn: More than sixteen hundred years ago, in the Jin dynasty, there was a man called Wang Xizhi. He began learning to write when he was very small. He practised every day and never stopped for a single day. After writing, he went to the river to wash his brush.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than sixteen hundred years ago, in the Jin dynasty, there was a man called Wang Xizhi.
comprehension.answer: 一千六百多年以前，晋朝有一个人，叫王羲之。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: He practised every day and never stopped for a single day.
comprehension.answer: 他每天都练习，一天也没有停过。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.prompt: 短文里的“多”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 多 (duō) means "more than" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
More than sixteen hundred years ago, in the Jin dynasty, there was a man called Wang Xizhi.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
